proposal.description: Blink terminal count is taken from the full blink period instead of the half-period, so each half of the square wave lasts the whole period
proposal.reason: While strikes are outstanding and no latch is present, Red_LED1 toggles at a different rate than LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS clocks per half, so the blink is slower than specified.

proposal.description: Blink counter is reloaded to 1 instead of 0 at the half-period terminal count, so every half-period after the first is one clock short
proposal.reason: With strikes outstanding, Red_LED1 edges after the first occur every LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS-1 clocks instead of LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS, so the blink drifts against the specified period.

proposal.description: Red_LED1 solid indication is driven by any live fault instead of only a latched trip
proposal.reason: When otp_state or uvlo_state is live with no latch, Red_LED1 goes solid (instead of off, or blinking if strikes are outstanding), duplicating Red_LED2/Red_LED3.

after: else if (latch_state || latch_assert || strike_level == STRIKE_W'(MAX_STRIKES_DEFAULT)) Red_LED1 <= 1'b1;
proposal.description: Strike level at its maximum is treated as a latched trip and shown solid instead of blinking
proposal.reason: With strike_level equal to MAX_STRIKES_DEFAULT and neither latch_state nor latch_assert high, Red_LED1 is held solid on instead of following the blink square wave.

proposal.description: Strike blink is suppressed while an OTP or UVLO fault is live, though strikes are still outstanding
proposal.reason: With strikes outstanding, no latch, and otp_state or uvlo_state high, Red_LED1 is driven off instead of blinking.

proposal.description: Running indication additionally requires power-good, conflating 'switching' with 'in regulation', so Green stays dark through soft-start
proposal.reason: During ss_active (or run_active) with no fault but pgood low, Green_LED stays off instead of lit.

proposal.description: Power-good LED is masked by any live fault instead of following the comparator directly
proposal.reason: With pgood high while otp_state, uvlo_state or a latch input is high, pgood_LED goes dark instead of showing the comparator.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is shown only once the converter has left S_RUN, not for the whole time OTP is live
proposal.reason: When otp_state is high while run_active is still high, Red_LED2 stays off instead of following the live OTP condition.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator is driven by the coarse any-fault summary instead of the UVLO condition alone
proposal.reason: With otp_state or a latch input high and uvlo_state low, Red_LED3 lights although there is no input undervoltage.
